title: kate-core: start an indent fold on the header line
summary: The character range of an indent fold starts on the header line at its line break. The header text stays outside the range. FoldSpan still names the header line. Linux CI runs the test.

lane.reason: The work is pure Rust in kate-core. Linux CI runs the test. It does not edit fold.rs.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: FoldSpan start stays the header line index. The character range starts at the line break that ends that header line. The header text stays outside the range. For a, newline, two spaces, b, newline, the range is offset 1 through offset 6. Update apply_indent_folds_stores_char_ranges to expect that range. Leave fold.rs unchanged. Leave workspace.rs unchanged. Leave keys.rs unchanged. PKT-0079 owns that file. Leave pair.rs unchanged. PKT-0083 owns that file. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: view::tests::apply_indent_folds_stores_char_ranges
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because the range is offset 0 through offset 6. The header line is a. The range starts on that line at the line break, offset 1, and ends at offset 6. The scalar a is outside the range.
